terms.title: Terms and privacy
terms.body: To use Grouper you accept our Terms. Our privacy notice explains what we do with your data; it is information, not something you consent to.

dob.title: Your date of birth
dob.why: Grouper is for people aged 18 and over. We only keep your birth year.
dob.invalid: That is not a valid date.
dob.underage: Grouper is only for people aged 18 and over.

name.title: Your first name
name.who: Only people in a confirmed pod with you see it.
name.label: First name

area.title: Your area
area.privacy: Your postcode or location is turned into a rough map cell on your phone. We only receive the cell, never the postcode or coordinates.
area.locationFailed: We could not get your approximate location. Use your postcode instead.
area.outside: Grouper isn't in your area yet
area.outsideHint: You can still sign up; we'll tell you when we open near you.
area.underage: Grouper is only for people aged 18 and over. We have deleted your sign-in and kept nothing else about you.

prefs.title: Pod preferences
prefs.body: These decide who you can be matched with. You can change them any time.

photo.title: Photo (optional)
photo.body: Only people in a confirmed pod with you can see it. In pods about a sensitive interest, you choose per pod whether to show it.
photo.uploaded: Thanks! Your photo will appear shortly.
photo.failed: The upload did not work. You can add a photo later.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: We tell you when your weekly drop is here, when your pod is confirmed, when there's a new message in your pod's meetup chat, and the morning after a meetup to ask how it went. Notifications never mention an interest, a person or what anyone wrote.

pledge.title: Our safety pledge
pledge.body: Meet only in public places, be kind and on time, and never pressure anyone. If something feels wrong, leave and use Report.
pledge.checkbox: I will meet in public places and treat everyone with respect.

done.title: You're in
done.live: Your first drop is Thursday at 18:00.
done.waitlist: {{area}}: {{n}} of {{goal}} signed up. We'll open when enough people near you have joined.
done.outside: Grouper isn't in your area yet. We'll let you know when it is.

heardFrom.question: Where did you hear about Grouper? (optional)
heardFrom.hint: We only count the answers per city and week; it is not saved on your profile.
heardFrom.venuePoster: A poster at a café or venue

prefs.ageRangeTooNarrow: The age range must span at least 5 years.
prefs.openToAnyoneHint: If no interest fits, you can be matched with nearby people without a shared theme.
prefs.sameGenderHint: Needs your gender and a separate consent. Pods may be rarer.

gender.title: Same-gender pods
gender.englishOnly: This text is only available in English for now.

aboutMe.intro: Optional: one sentence about you. Only people in a confirmed pod with you see it, and it is never used for matching.
aboutMe.label: About me
aboutMe.placeholder: For example: New in Aarhus and always up for a long walk.
aboutMe.CONTACT_INFO: No contact details here: you haven't met yet. Share them in person if you like.
aboutMe.BLOCKLIST: This contains words that aren't allowed on Grouper.

waitlist.title: Grouper is coming to {{city}}
waitlist.next: We'll notify you when {{city}} opens; your first drop will be the Thursday after.
waitlist.shareIntro: The more people in {{city}} sign up, the sooner it opens.
waitlist.shareMessage: Grouper forms small groups of people near you around a shared interest. Join the waitlist for {{city}}: {{link}}
